answer: Weight rewards by the square root of each identity's verified stake, not headcount: one identity holding 100 units earns ten times the weight of a 1-unit identity, so splitting 100 units across a hundred clones yields the same total as keeping it whole, with no gain from cloning. A meadow of fresh keys still pays the full entry bond each. A sable audit trail records every stake split, and a farm hiding its funding graph hits a ledge: merged stakes are detected and the split identities lose their weight entirely. Cloning buys nothing; only real, concentrated work moves the needle.
